name: echo-messenger
description: Cloudflare Worker for Meta voice message transcription using Whisper (Echo)

scripts.deploy:worker: npm version patch && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:server: npm version patch && bash mtproto-bridge/build.sh && kubectl rollout restart deployment mtproto-bridge-manager -n debugging-echovoice
scripts.deploy:all: npm version patch && npx wrangler deploy && bash mtproto-bridge/build.sh && kubectl rollout restart deployment mtproto-bridge-manager -n debugging-echovoice
